name: Kalyan Capitals Limited
about: Kalyan Capitals Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in lending business in India. The company provides loans to micro, small, and medium enterprises, as well as retail sectors for capital expenditure, working capital needs, trade finance, and other purposes; and gold loans. It also buys, invests in, acquires, and holds shares, stocks, debentures, debentures-stock, bonds, mutual funds, obligations, and securities. The company was formerly known as Akashdeep Metal Industries Limited and changed its name to Kalyan Capitals Limited in April 2023. Kalyan Capitals Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Ghaziabad, India.
